t: What a woman did with the only thing she was given
a: مَنْ يَلِي مِنْ هَذِهِ الْبَنَاتِ شَيْئًا فَأَحْسَنَ إِلَيْهِنَّ كُنَّ لَهُ سِتْرًا مِنَ النَّارِ
p: Man yalī min hādhihi-l-banāti shayʾan fa-aḥsana ilayhinna kunna lahu sitran mina-n-nār
m: Whoever is put in charge of any of these daughters and treats them well, they will be a screen for him from the Fire.
